hero_headline: Plans That Match How You Run Production
hero_sub: Operate, Guided, and Managed all include the AuraFlux member portal, Peaks, and the automated production pipeline. The difference is how much support you want.

operate.title: Self-serve
operate.subtitle: Full platform access. You run Peaks, jobs, and publish yourself from app.auraflux.co.
features: Member portal with Peaks (YouTube, Twitch, Kick)
API access for operators who want it

guided.title: Done-with-you
guided.subtitle: Same core platform as Operate, plus operator guidance so you are not alone in the dashboard.
features: Help refining workflows and job templates

managed.title: Done-for-you
managed.subtitle: We run production with you. Highest monthly credits plus Managed-tier add-ons like HeyGen and Imagen when ordered.

credit_note: Need more mid-cycle? Buy credit packs inside the AuraFlux app without changing your plan.
